title: Asterix: "const"-ify all the data structures.
description:
In addition to moving about 100 kBytes from a read-write data section to
read-only, this change also allows us to eliminate some typecasts (which
dropped "const" qualifiers) and hence stop suppressing some compiler
diagnostics (i.e. remove some DIAG_OFF_PEDANTIC/DIAG_ON_PEDANTIC pairs).

----

`epan/dissectors/packet-asterix.c` was regenerated using the updated `tools/asterix/update-specs.py`.  No new updates were incorporated into the source repository since the last `packet-asterix.c` update, so the changes to `packet-asterix.c` are solely from the modifications to the script.
